title: Scroll wheel events reach clients
body:
`State::input` in `src/compositor.rs` forwards pointer motion and buttons but
drops `InputEvent::PointerAxis`, so nothing scrolls under the mouse inside a
pane.

## Proposal

Build an `AxisFrame` from the event the way smithay's examples do, with the
discrete and v120 values when present, and send it through the seat's
pointer followed by a frame.
